# Massage Da Nang

> Every massage venue in Da Nang with a public Google rating, scored out of 100 on the same nine criteria. Google snapshot of 2026-11-27; websites read 2026-11-27. Prices in thousands of VND (100K ≈ $4).

## Where is the best massage in Da Nang?
Panda Spa Body & Foot Massage Danang (89.4/100) is first on this guide's score out of 100 for a massage in Da Nang. Every venue is scored on the same nine criteria, published on the methodology page. Top 5 on our 100-point score: 1. Panda Spa Body & Foot Massage Danang (89.4/100), 2. B Spa Bamboo Viet (89.4/100), 3. Panda Relax Spa (89.2/100), 4. Reborn Nails & Retreat (86.2/100), 5. Nón Spa - Massage, Nail, Hair Washing, Facial and Skin care (82.3/100). Our own count of 27 November 2026: of 238 massage venues, 77 publish a price list on a website of their own, 7 state there that English is spoken and 114 are within 1 km of My Khe beach; median published price of a 60-minute body massage: 420K VND (11 venues).
The ten first venues, with the matrix of points and the source of each cell: https://massage-da-nang.com/best-massage-da-nang/

## How much does a massage cost in Da Nang?
The median published price of a 60-minute body massage is 420K VND, across the 11 venues whose own website gives one. Venue by venue: https://massage-da-nang.com/prices/

## How is the score built?
Nine criteria, the same for every venue: Google rating weighted by its number of reviews (25), prices published in text (10) and durations (5), booking by WhatsApp or online (5), English stated (5) and confirmed in a review (5), hygiene described (5) or proven (10), range of treatments: body massage, foot massage, head spa, hot stone, Thai or shiatsu (15), opening hours (5), distance to the shore at My Khe (10), own website (5). Method: https://massage-da-nang.com/methodology/. Google's raw order: https://massage-da-nang.com/venues/by-google-rating/
